says: None of the videos in this theme came with recorded comments. The run 1 viewer questions show the demand clearly, though: "Can you make a video on retinol vs tretinoin?" (1,156 likes), "Which retinoid are you using? Please recommend something budget friendly." (1,116), "Do you use retinol every day?" (600) and "Can you please do one for in your 30s?" (101). People want the doctor's own routine and a list for their own decade, not a general lecture.
